name: startup-workspace
description: Startup velocity tools — pitch deck assistance, metrics dashboard generation, and launch coordination for solo founders and micro-teams
author: claude-code-workspace-starter

env.name: POSTHOG_API_KEY
env.description: PostHog API key for pulling analytics data

env.name: DATABASE_URL
env.description: PostgreSQL connection string for metrics and analytics

env.name: STARTUP_MONTHLY_BUDGET
env.description: Monthly infrastructure budget threshold in USD (triggers cost alerts)

env.name: COMMIT_REMINDER_THRESHOLD
env.description: Number of uncommitted files before showing a commit reminder
